base = keras.applications.EfficientNetB0(
    include_top=False, weights="imagenet",
    input_shape=(640, 640, 3), pooling="avg")
base.trainable = False  # fase 1: freeze backbone
inputs = keras.Input((640, 640, 3))
x = augment(inputs)
x = base(x, training=False)
x = keras.layers.Dropout(0.35)(x)
outputs = keras.layers.Dense(8, activation="softmax")(x)
model = keras.Model(inputs, outputs)
model.compile(optimizer=keras.optimizers.Adam(1e-3),
              loss="sparse_categorical_crossentropy",
              metrics=["accuracy"])

increases

Overfitting often arises from a combination of an overly flexible model, limited data, or evaluation leakage

Similar images, same background, duplication, noisy labels
RESPONS
Add meaningful variety; 
Check for duplicates & labels
MODEL TOO COMPLEX
Too many parameters for the size of the dataset
RESPONS
Transfer learning, 
Freeze backbone, & dropout/weight decay
TRAINING FOR TOO LONG
Training performance continues to improve; but validation
performance stagnates and then deteriorates
RESPONS
Early stopping + learning-rate schedule
DATA LEAKAGE
Augmented duplicates or the same source dataset to data test
RESPONS
Split before augmentation; group split; test locked

How to Hypertuning is Efficient
Zlobin, Mykola & Bazylevych, Volodymyr. (2025). BAYESIAN OPTIMIZATION FOR TUNING HYPERPARAMETRS OF MACHINE LEARNING MODELS: A PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS IN XGBOOST. Computer systems and information technologies.

Use callbacks to limit the number of epochs and restore the best weights; tuning should still be performed using validation data
22
callbacks = [
  keras.callbacks.EarlyStopping(
    monitor="val_loss", patience=5,
    restore_best_weights=True),
  keras.callbacks.ReduceLROnPlateau(
    monitor="val_loss", factor=0.2,
    patience=2, min_lr=1e-7),
  keras.callbacks.ModelCheckpoint(
    "best_model.keras",
    monitor="val_loss", save_best_only=True)
]
history = model.fit(
  train_ds, validation_data=val_ds,
  epochs=40, callbacks=callbacks)
EARLY STOPPING
Stop if validation loss does not improve; save the weights from
the best epoch
LR SCHEDULER
Reduce the learning rate when a plateau is reached, rather than
maintaining a high rate
CHECKPOINT
Save the best configuration and weights so that the experiment
can be restored
For a hybrid SVM: Tune C and gamma using cross-validation on the training set; the scaler
must be included within a Pipeline.
